riskConditions.floorPosition: Below, equal to or above the sunny threshold are all checked, as clarified during implementation. A higher saving floor is not a workaround because promotion releases that floor.
riskConditions.dynamic: Cheap/expensive saving, or normal-hour saving with normal-hour battery use enabled. Normal-hours saving that remains in force after promotion is excluded.
riskConditions.tou: Actual scheduled coverage has a saving tariff and a daytime charging opportunity; explicit import avoidance, unused/fully shadowed rates, empty schedules and night-only charging are excluded.
